title: High Dune Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutHigh Dune ~ 5231 West County Hwy 30A ~ Dune Allen FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. High Dune is a charming, historic post-and-pier 1,280sf Gulf front bungalow located in Dune Allen, with 4 bedrooms/2 baths, that sleeps 8. Private beach access, Oyster Lake view. The most economical Gulf Front home on 30A!! Daily beach service set-up (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) is included with your rental! A great location on the quiet, west end Dune Allen community - stock on up groceries, then never get in your car again! Delicious eateries within a 16-minute stroll - Stinky's Fish Camp, Shunk Gulley's Oyster Bar, Gulf Place (which is a great shopping and artist colony venue as well!). There's even a gas station/convenience store just a 4-minute walk away...come experience High Dune and see why families come back year after year to this simple, classic beach-front retreat! Main level: Living area opens onto Gulf front open deck. Dining table seats 6, with stools for 4 along granite counter. Fully equipped kitchen. #1 Bedroom is a Twin room that has 2 Twin beds, with access to front deck overlooking 30A and Oyster Lake. #2 Bedroom has a King bed, with obstructed Gulf view and access to Gulf front deck. Full bath, with walk-in shower, is shared by #1 and #2 Bedrooms. #3 Bedroom has a Queen and a Twin (bonus) bed, with access to front deck overlooking 30A and Oyster Lake. #4 Bedroom has a Queen bed, with Gulf view and access to Gulf front deck. Full bath, with tub/shower, is shared by #3 and #4 Bedrooms. Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Flat Screen TVs, DVD Player Distinctive Features Gulf front (private beach access) Oyster Lake view Daily beach service included (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) Bed, bath and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Parking for 4 vehicles. 1 King bed, 2 Queen beds, 3 twin beds 2 full bathrooms, iron, ironing board, 2 hair dryers, outdoor charcoal grill w/ grill utensils, 2 outdoor decks, deck furniture, enclosed outdoor shower. Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, electric stove/oven, refrigerator with ice maker, microwave, dishwasher, toaster, blender, toaster oven, washer, dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Grayton Beach (5.5 miles) Seaside (7 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
